newsitem.title: CANADA: Hurricane to pay US$120 mln in Kazakhstan oil deal.
newsitem.headline: Hurricane to pay US$120 mln in Kazakhstan oil deal.

text.p: Canada's Hurricane Hydrocarbons Ltd said on Thursday it would pay a total of US$120 million for the shares of Kazakhstan oil producer Yuzhneftegas as part of its successful takeover bid.
After weeks of uncertainty and intense negiotiations, Hurricane and Kazakhstan agreed on terms for the deal and signed a share purchase agreement on Wednesday in Almaty.
Hurricane said the acquisition of Yuzhneftegaz, which would be paid for in instalments, was expected to close before the end of November.
It said it would disclose more financial details later.
Under the deal, the Canadian company acquires all of Yuzneftegas's shares representing 89.9 percent of its equity.
JSC Yuzhneftegaz is a state-owned production association operating in the South Turgai Basin, in South Central Kazakhstan.
Current production from the region's Kumkol field is about 50,000 barrels of oil per day. Hurricane said it planned to boost output in the field to 75,000 in the next three years.
The company said it would take immediate management control of Yuzhneftegaz. An operations and management team would be deployed in early September. -- Reuters Calgary Bureau 403 531-1624
